Enterprise IT professional on the path to security engineering. By day I support enterprise systems at a HIPAA regulated hospital; the rest of the time I build security tooling for AWS with Terraform and Python.

### Featured Projects

**Cloud Security**
* [hipaa-aws-checker](https://github.com/markthedev12/hipaa-aws-checker): Read only Python CLI that audits AWS accounts across S3, IAM, CloudTrail, KMS, VPC, and RDS, mapped to HIPAA Security Rule controls.
* [aws-rds-secure-tier](https://github.com/markthedev12/aws-rds-secure-tier): Isolated, encrypted PostgreSQL tier in Terraform, plus a Boto3 audit that verifies the controls hold.
* [aws-ec2-devsecops-lab](https://github.com/markthedev12/aws-ec2-devsecops-lab): Terraform provisioned web server with a Python audit that flags internet exposed security groups.
* [aws-secure-s3-lab](https://github.com/markthedev12/aws-secure-s3-lab): Hardened S3 with least privilege IAM, encryption, HTTPS only access, logging, and CloudTrail.

**Identity & Infrastructure**
* [iam-access-review-bot](https://github.com/markthedev12/iam-access-review-bot): Flags stale entitlements against role baselines and generates risk scored HTML reports.
* [aws-route53-dns-failover-terraform](https://github.com/markthedev12/aws-route53-dns-failover-terraform): Active/passive DNS failover with Route 53 health checks, fully in Terraform.

### Background

**Stack:** AWS · Terraform · Python · Boto3 · Bash · Linux · GitHub Actions · Entra ID · Active Directory<br>
**Certs:** CompTIA Security+ · Google Cybersecurity · *in progress:* CompTIA CySA+, AWS Solutions Architect Associate<br>
**Education:** B.S. in Information Technology, Strayer University (June 2027)
